$comment: The one data file build.py reads to build the money-minor-units fixture, modelled on docs/case-study-money.md. 'people' are Larder's fourteen engineers; 'teams' are their four teams; 'scopes' are the 30 scopes the teams own, written into penguin/scopes.json with contracts as path::symbol; 'invariants' and 'examples' become penguin/invariants.json, and an example with a 'sample' is generated by build.py from that sample's spec; 'features' are every feature with its commits in source directories under features/<id>/. Each of the four use cases has one originating feature, marked with its 'case': 'accounts-merge' (1), 'structured-logs' (2), 'dependency-audit' (3) and 'money-minor-units' (4); main moves through them in that order. A commit with 'plan': true is where its feature's agent proposes the merge plan; a commit's 'declares' adds contracts and examples files to the penguin files of its tree; an examples entry with no 'sample' is a file in base/. Ines's feature 'money-minor-units' is the split: its first commit is the expand and its last the contract. A reader's 'migrate' commit is the migration its builder writes; a feature with the role 'migration' is the block Penguin opens from main for one owner's code on main, named as Penguin names it. A commit with 'onto': 'main' starts from main as it stands, as an agent that fetched main does. 'promotions' move main to a feature's head; 'split' holds the rewrite rules and retiring symbols Ines's agent declares with the expand. Commits are built in date order. docs/fixture-money.md describes every field.

base.message:
Base: Larder's 30 scopes with prices as floats in dollars

Teams, scopes, owners, agent identities and invariants are declared in penguin/.

invariants.statement: Every price is rounded to its currency's minor unit
The card charge equals the cart total
A shopper is charged at most once per order
A stored shopper keeps every attribute after the backfill
An order's total is the sum of its line totals
A stored order record reads back with the prices it was stored with
A refund never exceeds what was paid for the returned lines
An invoice's total due equals the card charge for the order
Tax is rounded per line item
Each order is taxed at its region's rate
A discount never takes a price below zero
A store's payout plus its fee equals the order total
A store fee rounds half up to the minor unit
A store is paid out at most once
A price band includes its lower bound
Daily revenue equals the sum of that day's order totals
Revenue in different currencies is never added together
Shoppers who log in on one pickup kiosk stay separate people
A published day's daily active users stay the same when later days' events arrive
A receipt shows the amount the customer paid
An unsubscribe on any linked identity holds after a later signup subscribes the address by default
The digest goes out at the shopper's local hour
An order payload carries its total for display and in the minor unit
Opening hours are in the store's local time
A holiday closure covers the store's whole local day
Only idempotent requests are retried
Log lines written at one instant go into one day's partition, whatever offset they carry
A flag's rollout is read when the flag service drops one request
A shopper's tier counts every order the shopper placed this year

sample.$comment: 5,000 recorded US orders, each drawn from the fixed seed with no filtering: one to max_lines lines, each with a price in price_cents and a quantity up to max_quantity, in one of the rates' regions.

commits.message:
Add Money beside the float price API

Money(amount_minor, currency) holds a whole number of the currency's minor unit.
shared/money gains Money.sum(), times(), scaled(), major() and display(), and
discounted() beside percent_off(). orders/model.py gains line_total_minor() and
order_total_minor() beside line_total() and order_total(). Nothing existing changes.

Remove the float price API with its own tests

No caller of price(), total(), display(), percent_off(), line_total() or
order_total() is left on main or in any running feature's own changes. Their own
tests in shared/money and orders leave with them; the Money tests stay.
